description: Run the specified command in a transient scope or service.

option.name: --background
tip: Set the ANSI color for the background.

option.name: --collect
tip: Unload the unit after it ran, even when failed.

option.name: --description
tip: Set the unit description.

option.name: --expand-environment
tip: Control expansion of environment variables.

option.name: --gid
tip: Run as the specified system group.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --host
tip: Operate on a remote host.

option.name: --ignore-failure
tip: Ignore the exit status of the invoked process.

option.name: --json
tip: Print the unit name and invocation ID as JSON.
Possible values: pretty, short, off

option.name: --machine
tip: Operate on a local container.

option.name: --nice
tip: Set the nice level.

option.name: --no-ask-password
tip: Do not prompt for a password.

option.name: --no-block
tip: Do not wait until the operation finishes.

option.name: --on-active
tip: Run after the specified delay.

option.name: --on-boot
tip: Run the specified time after the machine booted.

option.name: --on-calendar
tip: Run on the specified realtime calendar event.

option.name: --on-clock-change
tip: Run when the realtime clock jumps.

option.name: --on-startup
tip: Run the specified time after systemd activation.

option.name: --on-timezone-change
tip: Run when the timezone changes.

option.name: --on-unit-active
tip: Run the specified time after the last activation.

option.name: --on-unit-inactive
tip: Run the specified time after the last deactivation.

option.name: --path-property
tip: Set a path unit property.

option.name: --pipe
tip: Pass stdin/stdout/stderr directly to the service.

option.name: --property
tip: Set a service or scope unit property.

option.name: --pty
tip: Run the service on a pseudo TTY.

option.name: --quiet
tip: Suppress information messages during runtime.

option.name: --remain-after-exit
tip: Leave the service around until explicitly stopped.

option.name: --same-dir
tip: Inherit the working directory from the caller.

option.name: --scope
tip: Run this as a scope rather than a service.

option.name: --send-sighup
tip: Send SIGHUP when terminating.

option.name: --service-type
tip: Set the service type.
See systemd.service(5) Type= for the values.

option.name: --setenv
tip: Set an environment variable.

option.name: --shell
tip: Invoke $SHELL interactively.

option.name: --slice
tip: Run in the specified slice.

option.name: --slice-inherit
tip: Inherit the slice from the caller.

option.name: --socket-property
tip: Set a socket unit property.

option.name: --timer-property
tip: Set a timer unit property.

option.name: --uid
tip: Run as the specified system user.

option.name: --unit
tip: Run under the specified unit name.

option.name: --user
tip: Run as a user unit.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.

option.name: --wait
tip: Wait until the service stopped again.

option.name: --working-directory
tip: Set the working directory.
